utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you help collect a few extra tools and check if anyone has a spare ladder? I’ll swing by a bit late and handle the pickup list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll ask around for extra tools and see who has a spare ladder. Let me know when you’re on your way, and I’ll have the list ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — what time and where should I drop it off?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me confirm the exact time and address before I answer.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem — just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what we’ve got for the repair drive. Let me know what supplies you still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’m pretty sure we still need tape and a couple of screwdrivers, but I might be missing something.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll put tape and a couple screwdrivers on my list and check if we’ve got anything else in the shed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that repair drive—what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s kind of you. I’m just trying to sort out what’s broken and how we’d get the tools over there without making a mess of it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring a small toolkit and help carry things over quietly. If you tell me what’s broken, I’ll keep it simple and tidy.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get enough volunteers, or do you still need help?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet—I’ve only heard second-hand that they might still need a few more hands. I can check around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — could you check and tell me if they still need help?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’m keeping an ear out for the repair drive. If I learn anything, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. I’ve got a few tools ready if the drive needs anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great, Gus — I’ll let you know if they need a hand or any extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m definitely in — I’ll spread the word and see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — that really helps. Let me know who’s able to help, and I’ll keep track of where we’re set up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and send you names as soon as I hear back. We’ll get the word out fast.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh—just to confirm, you’re actually in for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m in for the repair drive—happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo — I’m ready to help organize the repair drive and keep things moving smoothly. What do you want me to take on first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — could you handle the sign-up list and let people know what tools we still need?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll set up the sign-up list and start checking off the tools we still need. I’ll keep you posted on what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m in for the repair drive — I’ll spread the word and keep reminding folks about it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Appreciate it, Vik. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll make a clear list, and you spread the word and reminders.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep reminding folks and let them know about the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just remind me what needs fixing again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. It’s mostly the porch step and the loose hinge on the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — the porch step and the back gate hinge. I can help with that; just tell me when you want me to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bridge folks for the repair drive—want me to check who’s available or spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you check who’s available and spread the word if you have time?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check who’s available and start spreading the word. I’ll keep you posted as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or bring you the details?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, put me down and send the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down, and I’ll send the details over soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is happening soon—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I just need a clear time and a list of what’s being fixed. If you can help keep things organized, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll check the time and put together a simple list of the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times for the repair drive. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great—thank you. Let’s aim for after pickup, around 3:30, so families can still make it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 works for me—I’ll plan around pickup and let folks know. Do you want me to bring any supplies?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I’m thinking the repair drive could really bring folks together—want me to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that’d be great—let’s tell folks and keep it simple. I can help repeat the plan around the block too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—I'll keep it short and clear, and you can help me get it around the block.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. Could you let me know which tools you’re bringing so I can make sure we don’t double up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring my hammer, adjustable wrench, tape measure, and a screwdriver set. If you already have any of those covered, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked any repair-drive spots yet, but I can keep an eye out and note the locations as soon as I see them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that would be a big help. Just jot down the spot and I’ll keep the repair drive list updated.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll write down each spot as I spot it and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — what time is the repair drive starting, and where should I bring the donations?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I say for sure — do you have the flyer or the organizer’s message handy?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t have it on me right now, sorry. If you want, I can check and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you keep an eye out for extra screws, duct tape, and a working flashlight?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out for screws, duct tape, and a working flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting organized, but I’m still catching up on the details. What’s the latest on where they need help?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think they still need folks for sorting donated parts and maybe helping with pickup drops, but I might’ve missed the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the latest and see if I can help with sorting or pickups.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on, right? Just want to make sure I’ve got that confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — no changes there. I’ll let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — thanks for confirming. I’ll keep it on my side too, unless you say otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting some good momentum. I can swing by and spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Ira. Thank you for spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll mention it to a few folks while I’m out and see if anyone can chip in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring the tape and totally blanked. If you need help, I can still swing by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — if you can bring the tape later, that’d help a lot. I’m here working on it now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I can do that — I’ll grab the tape and come by a bit later. Thanks for keeping at it, Leo.
